## Why it matters

This database documents Islam and Muslim communities in West Africa through archival documents, newspaper articles, Islamic publications, photographs, audio, and video.

Its multilingual metadata, OCR, map browse, and indexed people, places, events, and topics make it valuable for regional and transnational research beyond manuscript studies alone.
